checklists.title: Pickup inspection
checklists.description: Assembled from the supplied guides. No source contains a formal pickup list, so every line below is drawn from a cited walk-around, keys, equipment or fuel instruction.

items.text: Complete an outside tour of the RV and confirm all hook-ups are detached and properly stowed in their compartments.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm all external compartments are locked and latched.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Note the location of the generator exhaust pipe on the driver's side.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Check the height sticker on the windshield and note your RV's height.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Rear storage: camping table, power cord, electrical adapter, water hose, water pressure regulator, coax cable, broom, dustpan and brush, two cleaning rags, leveling ramps and spare wheel.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Smaller items are usually rolled up with the hose or cord — look carefully to verify it all.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Sewer hose is stored in the front side compartment.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Locate the fire extinguisher, usually near the entry door step well.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Locate the LPG / carbon-monoxide detector — its position varies by model and it is usually close to the floor.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Locate the emergency exit window, marked EXIT on one of the rear windows.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm you have one complete set of keys: ignition/lock box, outside storage bin doors, coach door and engine compartment.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Note the On Road Care phone number printed on the key tag and save it in My RV settings.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Review the paperwork in the glove compartment, including registration, insurance details and the Collision Report forms.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Note the fuel level. You must return the RV with the same fuel level you received at pickup.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Note the propane level. The tank is full at pickup and must be refilled to the same level before return.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm the waste tanks are empty and the freshwater tank is full.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Ask which configurations your RV has: shore power service, number of A/C units, water heater type, refrigerator type, generator start locations, leveling system, and whether an awning and oven are fitted. Record them in My RV settings.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Read the instruction sticker beside the slide switch and note the correct driver's seat position for your RV.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

checklists.title: Arriving at Burning Man
checklists.description: Assembled from the Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide. Every line is cited.

items.text: Level on solid, near-level ground using the auto-leveling feature only. Never lift the wheels off the ground.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Make sure your RV stays accessible to service trucks — hoses cannot reach beyond 30 feet.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Do not open or use the awning.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Cover everything inside the RV with sheets.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Cover the floor with thick brown paper secured with BLUE painter's tape only.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Cover the window screens — playa dust is nearly impossible to remove from them.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Wrap the awning ends with shrink-wrap to keep dust out.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Close all windows and roof vents and keep them closed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Keep all exterior compartment doors closed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Confirm the coach battery switch is ON. It must always be ON or the batteries do not get charged.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Set the A/C thermostat to 79 degrees and close blinds, curtains and shades.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: If the refrigerator runs on propane, set it to PROPANE.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Plan to run only one A/C unit at a time on generator power.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Set up your cooler or ice chest for drinks and water.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

checklists.title: Daily morning check
checklists.description: Assembled from the supplied guides. No source defines a daily check, so every line is drawn from a cited instruction.

items.text: Check the engine oil on level ground, engine off and cold. Morning before driving is the best time.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Check the generator oil if it has run eight hours since the last check.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Check the fuel gauge. The generator will not run below a quarter tank.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Check the coach battery reading on the monitor panel with the engine, generator and shore power off.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Check the fresh, grey and black tank levels on the monitor panel.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Run the engine for one hour, as one of at least three sessions across the day — or run the generator for eight hours.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: While the generator is running, use the power-heavy appliances and charge phones and laptops.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Do not run the generator or engine if there is a dust storm. Wait for it to pass.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Confirm windows and roof vents are closed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Confirm exterior compartment doors are closed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Confirm the awning is closed and has not been used.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Check for any leaks under the RV. You are responsible for preventing and addressing any leaks.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

checklists.title: Daily evening check
checklists.description: Assembled from the supplied guides. Every line is cited.

items.text: Run the engine for one hour before going to sleep. The guide singles this session out specifically.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Confirm the coach battery switch is still ON.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Turn the water pump off when water is not required.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Do not run the generator at night or during posted quiet hours. Burning Man recommends using generators sparingly out of consideration for your neighbours.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Confirm windows, roof vents and exterior compartments are closed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Keep the deadbolt locked.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Turn off the water heater when you are finished with it.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Check the generator oil level — daily, or after every eight hours of operation.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm the fuel tank is above a quarter, or the generator will not start.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm the coach battery is charged. The generator needs a well charged coach battery to start.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm there is no dust storm. Do not run the generator or engine during a dust storm.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Turn off the roof air conditioning, microwave and anything plugged into the outlets.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close the windows. Generator exhaust could trigger the detectors.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Allow the generator 3 to 4 minutes to warm up before using any appliances.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Run only one A/C unit at a time to avoid tripping the generator breaker.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Use this window for the microwave, device charging and any other 120-volt loads.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Do not run the generator at night or during posted quiet hours.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

checklists.title: Dust storm procedure
checklists.description: The supplied rental guide covers dust storms in one instruction only: do not run the generator or engine. The remaining items are its general dust-protection measures. This app carries no guidance on personal protection, sheltering or driving in a whiteout, because none of the supplied sources cover it. Follow Burning Man's own event guidance and any direction from event staff.

items.text: Do not run the generator or engine during a dust storm. Dust can clog the air filter and damage the engine or generator.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Keep windows and roof vents closed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Only open the entry door when entering or exiting.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Keep all exterior compartment doors closed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Confirm the awning is closed. It is not to be used on the playa at all.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Limit the opening and closing of the refrigerator doors.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Use the cooler or ice chest for drinks and water.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Resume the normal charging schedule once the storm has passed.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: If you smell propane, a detector alarms, or smoke builds up, open the windows, roof vents and entry door immediately. Emergency ventilation always takes precedence over the dust guidance.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

checklists.title: Preparing for an RV service truck

items.text: Make sure your RV is accessible. Service hoses cannot reach beyond 30 feet.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Clear bikes, shade structures and camp furniture from the route to your sewer outlet.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Look for trucks marked 'RV servicing'. Many trucks are for infrastructure only, so check the signage.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: The only vendor authorised to accept cash for pumping is United Site Services.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Pumping services do not include potable water refills. Look for separate potable water trucks.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Unlock and open the sewer outlet access before the truck arrives.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Add a toilet chemical pack after the black tank has been emptied.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close and lock the exterior sewer outlet afterwards.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close all roof vents and coach windows.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close cabinet doors, drawers and counter extensions.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Properly secure the fridge and freezer doors.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close the bathroom door.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Switch off the water heater, water pump, furnace, stove and generator.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Secure the TV and the bunk ladder.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Stow and secure all dishes, luggage and equipment. Lighter items higher, heavier items lower.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Raise the cab-over bed for extra headroom and visibility, if fitted.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Retract the slide-outs. Never drive with a slide in the OUT position.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Retract the awning and confirm it is fully rolled up.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Retract the leveling system, then step outside and visually confirm all jacks are fully retracted.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Confirm the entry step has retracted. Listen for it moving and double-check before driving off.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Disconnect the power cord and fresh water hose from the campsite outlets and stow them.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close and lock the exterior sewer outlet.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Lock and latch all compartment doors.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close the entry door and engage the deadbolt.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Check there is no evidence of fluid leaks under the RV.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Check for overhead clearance. At least 13 feet is required.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Perform a walk-around tour.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Adjust the seat, steering wheel and mirrors before starting the engine.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Buckle up. All passengers must wear seat belts while the RV is moving.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Release the parking brake.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Use a spotter when manoeuvring in tight spaces, parking lots and campgrounds.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Pack it in, pack it out. Do not leave anything behind at Black Rock City.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Bag all trash, with separate bags for recyclables.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Check the ground around your camp for anything dropped or spilled.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Arrange a final pump-out with an RV servicing truck if your tanks are near full.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Never dump grey or black water on the playa on the way out.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Retract the jacks and confirm visually that they are fully up.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Retract the slide-outs and confirm the entry step is in.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm windows, roof vents and all exterior compartments are closed and latched.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Do not drive if rain has softened the playa. The rental agreement prohibits driving in conditions you reasonably understand to be hazardous.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Dispose of your trash during the return trip. Many communities along the route offer 24-hour recycling and trash disposal.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Do not bring your trash to the return branch — substantial disposal fees will apply.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Plan your playa dust cleaning stop before you reach the branch.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Do not use standard cleaning products or water inside the RV — this will only smear the dust and create mud.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Use a vinegar wash.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Remove the sheets and floor paper carefully so the trapped dust leaves with them.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: Remove all blue painter's tape. Additional cleaning or repainting fees apply if removal is required.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: The interior — appliances, bathroom, cupboards, all surfaces and the floor.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: The awning.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: The outer storage compartments.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: The undercarriage.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: The generator.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: The window screens, which are the hardest surface to clean.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide
sources.section: Tips from Fellow Burning Man Travelers

items.text: The floor needs to be broom clean; it does not need to be mopped.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: A minimum cleaning fee of $500 applies if the vehicle is not returned in the exact same clean condition inside and outside as at pickup.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: A minimum fee of $2,000 applies if the vehicle is returned completely uncleaned, unless a $1,500 cleaning fee was prepaid.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Turn the engine off and apply the parking brake.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Turn the house battery / battery disconnect switch OFF.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Turn the generator off.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Close the propane gas shut-off valve.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Use gasoline only, minimum 87 octane unleaded. Never use diesel.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Twist the gas cap a few full turns until it is tight.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Double-check the gas gauge before leaving the station.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Refill propane at a service station, U-Haul location or campground that handles propane.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Propane must be refilled before return. The refuelling fee is $6.50 per gallon.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Turn the battery disconnect switch back ON.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Open the propane gas shut-off valve.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: For the return leg, fill up close to the return location — not 15 miles away. The gasoline refuelling fee is $10.00 per gallon.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: There are no RV dump stations in Black Rock City. Use a truck marked 'RV servicing'.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Never dump grey water or black water on the playa. Violators will be cited by BLM.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: The only vendor authorised to accept cash for pumping is United Site Services.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Take the sewer hose from the storage compartment and remove the dust cap from the sewer outlet.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Attach the hose firmly to the outlet and twist to lock. Attach the elbow if not already connected.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Place the opposite end into the dump connection.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Save a few plastic shopping bags to use as makeshift gloves when handling the hose.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: Pull the BLACK handle first — the larger of the two, or the one marked BLACK.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Once the black waste has completely drained, flush the toilet with 1 to 2 gallons of fresh water to rinse the tank.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close the BLACK valve.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Pull the GREY handle. This flushes out water from the sinks and shower and helps rinse the hose.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

items.text: When the grey tank has drained, raise the hose at the RV end and work hand-over-hand towards the far end to drain it.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close the GREY valve.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Detach and stow the sewer hose, and replace the cap on the outlet pipe securely.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Add one packet of toilet chemical to the toilet and flush. Repeat this every time you drain the tanks.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: It is normal if the tank sensors do not read fully empty. Build-up on the inside affects readings.

sources.document: El Monte Class A Walkthrough Transcript

checklists.title: Return Checklist
checklists.description: Everything to complete before you hand back the keys, ending with the final return inspection.

items.text: Dispose of all trash during the return trip. Many communities along the route from Black Rock City offer 24-hour recycling and trash disposal.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Do not bring your trash to the return branch — substantial disposal fees will apply.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Remove all garbage from the RV.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Drain the waste tanks.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Add a toilet chemical pack after emptying the black tank.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Emptying the freshwater tank is not required.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Fill the fuel tank to the same level as at pickup. Fill close to the return location, not 15 miles away.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Double-check the gas gauge before leaving the station. The refuelling fee is $10.00 per gallon.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Fill the propane tank to the same level as at pickup. The propane refuelling fee is $6.50 per gallon.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Clean the playa dust using a vinegar wash. Do not use standard cleaning products or water inside the RV.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Clean the interior, the awning, the outer storage compartments, the undercarriage and the generator.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Wash all dishes and put them back in the kitchen cabinets and drawers.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Clean the appliances, bathroom, cupboards and all surfaces. The floor needs to be broom clean, not mopped.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Remove all blue painter's tape and any decorations from the exterior.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Re-check all cupboards and storage compartments for personal items.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Check the glovebox, the cab, the bunks and the exterior compartments.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Anything left behind is considered abandoned and will be disposed of immediately without further notice.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Pack all luggage before arriving at the drop off branch.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Return within the 30-minute time slot selected during your Self Check-in.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Late returns are charged the price difference for the new slot plus $50 per hour. Unauthorised extensions are billed at double the nightly rate.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Allow time — drop off may take a while to complete. Schedule onward travel accordingly.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Do not leave the vehicle outside the rental lot. Vehicles left in unsafe or unauthorised areas are subject to towing and fines.

sources.document: Burning Man 2026 RV Rental Guide

items.text: Retract the slide-outs, awning and leveling jacks, and confirm the entry step is in.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close and lock the exterior sewer outlet and all exterior compartments.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Close all roof vents and coach windows.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Switch off the water heater, water pump, furnace, stove and generator.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Walk around the outside and confirm every compartment is latched and nothing is trailing.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Confirm the fuel and propane gauges match the pickup levels.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Hand over one complete set of keys. If keys are separated, the guest is responsible for all replacement costs.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A

items.text: Keep every receipt for oil, fuses, smoke detector batteries and approved repairs for reimbursement.

sources.document: El Monte RV Guest Guide — Class A
